$comment: THE REAL SCOPE REGISTRY for this portfolio, as opposed to artifacts/scope-registry.example.json,
which documents the shape with fictional entries.
It is committed here, in StandardsEnforcer, because a registry must live where the repositories it
governs cannot write to it. None of the repositories registered below is this one.
`standards` is the PACK ROSTER, and registration is transcription (ADR 0008). The map key must
equal `contract.id`, which is the identity the pack declares in its own standards-adapter.json,
and `sourceRef` names the commit that identity was read out of. A registry may register a pack; it
may not rename one. Nothing here is normalised, because normalising `machineLearning` into
`machine-learning` would be this enforcer deciding what a pack is called -- and a representation
mismatch nobody was watching is exactly the false green FE-12 found.
FIVE PACKS IN THIS PORTFOLIO ARE ABSENT, AND THAT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN TIDIED AWAY.
EngineeringStandards, FinancialStandards, HealthAndFitnessAndNutritionStandards,
PredictionStandards and UIUXDesignStandards publish no standards-adapter.json, so they declare no
contract identity, so there is nothing to transcribe. Registering them under their directory name
would key every one of their cells on a spelling no pack agreed to. They are unregistrable today,
and a pack missing from the matrix must not look like a pack missing from the world.
`repositories` IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE FINDING RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT. An entry is keyed by an
immutable platform identity -- GitHub's numeric repository id or node id -- which only the platform
can issue. Obtaining them for the ~60 repositories on this machine means enumerating an
organisation, which is repository discovery, which this enforcer does not do (FE-07). Inventing a
local identity instead would key the whole portfolio on something rename-safe by accident: a root
commit collides across forks, a path is not an identity, and a directory name is the failure ADR
0004 settled.
So the honest state of applicability governance on 2026-08-13 is: four packs registered, zero
repositories registered, zero cells. The ratchet reports POPULATION_EMPTY rather than passing over
nothing. See artifacts/evidence/2026-08-13-portfolio-first-matrix.md.
